title: LOGOS ASF Synthetic Doctrine Record
description: Schema for a single synthetic instruction record generated from approved Lane 1 owned doctrine sources. Training is NOT authorized on these records without further operator review.

created_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of batch generation (same for all records in a batch).

synthetic_origin.description: Always true. Identifies this record as synthetically generated, never from a real interaction.

source_id.description: Source registry ID of the Lane 1 doctrine source used for generation.

source_registry_version.description: Version of the source registry at time of generation.

clearance_ledger_entry_id.description: Ledger entry ID of the clearance approval decision for this source.

generation_agent_id.description: Identifier of the agent or automated process that generated this record.

prompt_template_id.description: Stable identifier for the template that produced this record.

prompt_hash.description: SHA-256[:32] of 'prompt_template_id:input' — enables deterministic audit replay.

category.description: Instruction category from the governed taxonomy.

input.description: Synthetic instruction input. No real user transcripts, credentials, or private thresholds.

desired_output.description: Expected governed response for the synthetic input.

governance_labels.description: Hard governance flags. All deny-by-default constants enforced at schema and code level.

training_allowed.description: Always false. Operator review required before any SFT use.
